_about: Every number the Kestrel plan tools use. Each leaf is {value, src}. Hand-copied from docs/kestrel/00-facts.md (F ids), docs/design/scale-sheet.md, docs/kestrel/S0-security-spec.md section 5 (SN ids), docs/kestrel/RULES.md, docs/kestrel/02-building-brief.md section 7 and the P03 prompt. A number that is not here is not used; a check that needs one prints SKIP (no fact).

maxSlope.src: src/player/playerController.ts maxSlopeCosine = cos 50 degrees (steepest ground the player stands on; tests/editor/roofGeometry.test.ts keeps them equal)

mainWidth.src: handover Decisions Main stair (standards-check.mjs main stair minimum); ON2 editor default for a main stair

fallMin.src: ON10 brief (Michael 2026-10-13): flat roof fall 1-2 degrees

fallMax.src: ON10 brief (Michael 2026-10-13): flat roof fall 1-2 degrees

upstand.src: ON10 brief (Michael 2026-10-13): upstand 0.3 with no parapet

levelTol.src: ON10: a flat roof top within this of the roof level's floor matches it

corridor.src: handover Decisions H7 and brief R4: corridor ceilings 2.4 under the 1.5 m voids (a new corridor ceiling starts here)

min.src: editor default: typical product (the lowest ceiling the card steps to: a 2.1 m door head); below it the ceiling is none

endReach.src: ON13 editor default: a crawl end within this of a vent or a hatch takes it

widthMin.src: ON13 brief decision 3 (one 600 mm crawl board)

widthMax.src: ON13 brief decision 3; F32 crouch width

widthDefault.src: F32 crouch width (standards-check.mjs: a crawl space's clear short side at least 1.2)

plateCentre.src: ON14 brief decision 5: a door name plate at 1.5 m

plateGap.src: ON14 editor default: a name plate sits this far beyond the door's latch edge, on the wall

wallCentre.src: editor default: typical (a wall-mounted safety or direction sign at about eye level and just above, 1.5-2.0 m)

hangGap.src: ON14 editor default: a hung sign's top this far under the ceiling (its chains)

hangBottomMin.src: editor default: a hung sign clears a 2.1 m door head (facts door.singleHeight is the door's own)

wallReach.src: ON14 editor default: a sign backs onto a wall face within this distance of the dot (as light.wallReach)

panelThick.src: src/world/detailPass.ts:94: the game's own signs are 0.02 m panels (under lightShapes CANON_MIN_THICK, so never a light shape)

arrayMax.src: ON14 editor default: at most this many copies in one Array

calLumens.src: ON6 brief decision 3 (editor): a 900 lm downlight is the calibration point

calBeam.src: ON6 brief decision 4: the 900 lm downlight beam (degrees)

radiusMin.src: editor default: smallest light reach the conversion gives (a step light)

radiusMax.src: editor default: longest light reach the conversion gives (lampBake boxes stay small)

intensityMin.src: editor default: dimmest intensity the conversion gives

intensityMax.src: editor default: brightest intensity the conversion gives (the game maps use up to 1.0)

spotBeamMax.src: editor default: beams narrower than this (degrees) are spot cones; wider light the hemisphere below (lampMath LAMP_CONE)

wallReach.src: editor default: a wall fitting or a switch backs onto a wall face within this distance of the dot (beyond the dot magnet's 0.5 m pull to a wall line)

openingReach.src: editor default: an exit sign snaps to an opening whose middle is within this distance of the dot

signAbove.src: editor default: an exit sign centre this far above the door head

lampPick.src: editor default: A with a switch adds the lamp within this distance of the dot

mapCell.src: ON7 brief decision 4: the darkness map and the guard view sample every 0.5 m cell of the level's floor

surfaceGap.src: map lamps hang 0.15 m under their ceilings (src/world/maps/mansion.ts H1 - 0.15): the light bake grows solids by half a 0.2 m cell, so a light point nearer a ceiling or wall is inside it and lights nothing

stepMax.src: F04 (src/player/movement.ts pickTraversal: step up to 0.65, top clear)

vaultDepth.src: F04 (pickTraversal: vault depth up to 1.0, landing clear)

mantleMax.src: F04 (pickTraversal: mantle up to 1.8, top clear)

wallJoinTol.src: ON0b (Michael 2026-10-13): a wall end within this of another wall meets it (corners join)

wallGapMax.src: ON0b (Michael 2026-10-13): a wall end this near another wall but not on it is a Gap

ringStepMax.src: P03 Part C A29 (rings differ by at most one step; 3+ is one step above 3)

cameraSweepDefault.src: SN15 reason (a 90 deg sweep cycle = 16 s)

cameraSweepStep.src: ON12 editor default: a pan camera's sweep steps 10 degrees on the card

cameraAimStep.src: ON12 editor default: a camera's facing steps 5 degrees on the card

cameraMountDefault.src: S0 section 6 example camera y 3.0 (inside SN04)

pirWallHeight.src: ON12 editor default: typical product (a wall PIR sensor at 2.0-2.5 m)

pirWallFan.src: ON12 editor default: S0 2.6 tests range only, on its level; a wall sensor sees the half in front of its wall

beamHeightDefault.src: SN40 (the middle of the high band)

monitorMax.src: ON12 editor default: typical product (a 16-way video wall)

pipeLipRise.src: src/player/attachController.ts pipeLip: a drainpipe climbs off onto a hangable ledge whose top is within 0.8 of the pipe top

wallReach.src: ON5 editor default: a wall piece backs onto a wall face this near the dot (as the Ladder tool's reach)

ledgeDepth.src: ON5 brief decision 1: ledge or string course depth 0.15-0.3

ledgeThick.src: editor default: typical product (a stone string course, 150 mm high)

sillDepth.src: editor default: typical product (a precast window sill standing out from the wall face)

sillThick.src: editor default: typical product (a precast window sill, 100 mm)

copingThick.src: editor default: typical product (precast concrete coping, 100 mm)

copingOverhang.src: editor default: typical product (a 50 mm drip each side of the wall)

ventW.src: editor default: typical product (a 600 x 600 louvred grille)

ventH.src: editor default: typical product (a 600 x 600 louvred grille)

ventSill.src: editor default: a low wall grille, its bottom 300 mm above the floor

lampPost.src: editor default: typical product (a car park lighting column, 6 m)

lampPostSize.src: editor default: typical product (a 150 mm steel column)

fenceHeight.src: editor default: typical product (a security chain-link fence, 2.4 m)

fenceRattle.src: F14 (src/config/movement.ts FENCE.rattle; tests/editor/climb.test.ts keeps them equal)

navCell.src: src/ai/navBuild.ts:72 (the AI nav grid cell, cell: 0.5); ON8 legs are searched on the same cell

agentRadius.src: src/ai/navBuild.ts:73 (agentRadius: 0.32, the guard's footprint the nav grid keeps clear)

stepHeight.src: src/ai/navBuild.ts:74 (stepHeight: 0.45): an object lower than this does not block a guard

walk.src: F20 (src/config/enemies.json walkSpeed; tests/editor/mission.test.ts keeps them equal); a looped patrol walks at walkSpeed (src/ai/enemy.ts:988, a loop route's pace is 1)

waitStep.src: ON8 brief decision 2: a stop's wait steps 1 s, from 0

faceStep.src: ON8 editor: RB turns a stop's facing 45 degrees (the right stick aims it freely)

stopPick.src: ON8 editor: A within this of the first stop closes the loop; picks a stop

connectorReach.src: ON8 editor: a stair or ladder joins a leg at the walkable cell nearest it within this

maxSpawns.src: schema.md section 3 spawns (1-4 players; co-op is 2-4)

previewRate.src: ON8 brief decision 6: the patrol preview walks at the guard's own speed (real time)

latitude.src: Overnight choice (ON15): RULES section 1 puts Kestrel in a northern British city and no doc gives a latitude; 54 degrees north (northern hemisphere: the moon's arc runs through the south)

declination.src: editor default: the simple sky path's moon declination, a winter full moon's (opposite the late-November sun at about -20 degrees), so it rises north of east at dusk, stands highest in the south at midnight and sets north of west at dawn

dusk.src: editor default: the slider's dusk, 16:00 (minutes after midnight); late November at 54 N the sun sets about 15:50

dawn.src: editor default: the slider's dawn, 08:00 (minutes after midnight); late November at 54 N the sun rises about 08:00

timeStep.src: editor default: the time-of-night slider steps 10 minutes

bearingStep.src: ON15 brief decision 1: the moon's compass bearing steps 5 degrees

heightStep.src: editor default: the moon's height steps 5 degrees, as the bearing

heightMin.src: editor default: the lowest moon height the bake takes (a moon on the horizon casts endless shadows)

heightMax.src: editor default: the highest moon height (straight overhead has no bearing)

briefTime.src: docs/kestrel/01-mission-brief.md section 2: a Tuesday in late November, 01:10 start (minutes after midnight)

briefBrightness.src: docs/kestrel/01-mission-brief.md section 2: a thin waning moon behind cloud, so the yard has no moonlight (the game's scale: new, no moon light)

wallExtend.src: P03 style: fraction of thickness added at each wall end so corners fill

faceTick.src: P03 style: metres, guard facing tick

charWidth.src: P03 style: average glyph width as a fraction of the font size

labelSmallBelow.src: P03 style: rooms with a short side under this many px use the small font

flagFrac.src: P03 style: flag width as a fraction of its pole

labelSteps.src: P03 style: label candidate spots per axis inside a room

labelSpread.src: P03 style: fraction of the room the label candidates cover

calloutGap.src: P03 style (drawing only): px between a leader line and its text

calloutPad.src: P03 style (drawing only): px between stacked callouts

roomNameRange.src: ON3 brief decision 2 (editor only): floating room names in 3D hide beyond this many metres

handlePx.src: Michael 2026-10-14 editor fix-up (editor only): selection handles keep this many pixels on screen in 3D and on the plan
